abilities.name: Weighted Spike
_curatorNotes: Out-of-NS polearm normals: 3-hit Physical chain. attackHitmarks=[13,16,12]; attackFrames built via InitNormalCancelSlice(hitmark, animLen).
Per-hit overrides: N1 ActionAttack=22/Charge=22; N2 ActionAttack=22/Charge=25; N3 ActionAttack=41/Charge=500 (illegal — final hit C key omitted per convention).
Charge: chargeFrames=InitAbilSlice(55), ActionAttack/Skill/Swap=49 ActionBurst=50 ActionDash/Jump=24 (chargeHitmark). Standard polearm CA shape. Multiplier charged[lvl=10]=198.22% Physical.
Plunge frames not authored — Iansan has no plunge.go in gcsim source.

abilities.name: Weighted Spike (Swift Stormflight)
abilities.caveat: While in Nightsoul's Blessing, Iansan's Charged Attack becomes Swift Stormflight: a single Electro stomp at swiftHitmark=14f (166.4% ATK Electro at lvl=10) instead of the base lunge CA. Normals themselves stay Physical. There is also a 5s post-skill window (gcsim 'fastSkill' status) during which N input auto-converts to a Swift Stormflight CA — the planner only matches NS state, so the post-skill 5s 'free CA' window is not separately gated.
_curatorNotes: Dual normal authored to switch chargeFrames during NS. Hits[] frames are identical to the base normal (N1-N3 don't change in NS); only chargeFrames swap to swiftFrames=InitAbilSlice(52) with ActionAttack/Skill=51 ActionJump=50 ActionSwap=49. Swift Stormflight hitmark=14f.
Authored as a normal-typed dual variant with state condition (varesa/cyno-shape). NO `infusion` field — base normals stay Physical even in NS; only the CA changes element.

fastSkill 5s post-skill window: gcsim auto-converts N → CA during this window even before NS exit. Schema can't gate on a per-cast post-action transient (apexDrive-equivalent gap). The state:nightsoulBlessing match covers the dominant case (NS active = CA replaced).

abilities.name: Thunderbolt Rush
_curatorNotes: Skill cast: AoE Nightsoul Electro at skillHitmark=21f, 515.52% ATK Electro elemental art. 4 Electro particles per cast (via particleCB, gated on c.particleGenerated flag).

enterNightsoul(54): max NS = 54. Drain rate = 0.6 per 6f = 6/sec → max NS duration ~9s. Modeled as duration:9 (stance window). gcsim setNightsoulExitTimer(16*60) is a max safety timer that effectively never fires unless NS is replenished by team movement/burst — the practical duration is 9s drain time.

E3 v2 (2026-05-11): authored gainStacks effect for the +54 NS grant with drain spec (6/sec while nightsoulBlessing). Drain semantics live on the parser; future consumers gating on stacks {key:'nightsoul'} or perStack scaling will see decayed values at every cast snapshot. Burst's flat-ATK effect remains `value: unknown` — the NS<42 vs NS≥42 threshold-formula switch needs a separate primitive (see deferred items in E3 v2 hand-off).

Cooldown: SetCD(skill, 16*60) at cast (NOT at stance end). Schema's stance + cooldown counts from cast frame, so phase-1/2 (active 9s) overlaps phase-3 (ghost CD 7s) — three-phase E bar renders correctly.
Frames: skillFrames=InitAbilSlice(43), ActionDash=31 ActionJump=32 ActionSwap=42. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — N, Q omitted overrides default to animLen=43.

terminatesOnSwap: false — gcsim allows Iansan to be off-field while NS is active (the burst Scale extends NS). Setting to false matches the off-field-while-Scale-up case; for the skill-only case (no burst), NS exits on its own timer regardless of swap. Acceptable simplification.

5s 'fastSkill' window after E cast: any N press auto-converts to Swift Stormflight CA. Not separately modeled — the state:nightsoulBlessing match on the in-NS normal variant covers the dominant case (NS is also active during fastSkill window).
abilities.description:
Iansan charges forward a certain distance, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to all opponents in her path.
After this Skill is used, Iansan will regain 54 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Within 5s after this is done, using a Normal Attack will trigger 1 quick Swift Stormflight stomp from Iansan that will not consume Stamina.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Iansan
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. If she runs out, or uses this Skill again, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. It has the following properties:
· Increases Iansan's Movement SPD.
· Holding sprint will switch Iansan to Rushing Thunderbolt mode, greatly increasing her Movement SPD temporarily. In this mode, Iansan can make flying leaps using terrain, or consume additional Nightsoul points to move on water or liquid Phlogiston while being immune to DMG from the latter.

abilities.name: The Three Principles of Power
_curatorNotes: Burst hit at burstHitmark=34f: 774.72% ATK Electro AoE elemental burst. Spawns Kinetic Energy Scale at the same frame (gcsim Tasks.Add at burstHitmark). On cast: enterNightsoul(15) or +15 NS if already in stance.

E3 v2 (2026-05-11): authored gainStacks effect for the +15 NS grant. Drain field intentionally omitted per convention (drain declared on the introducing E gainStacks for the same key). The burst-opens-NS-from-zero edge case (Q without prior E) is not separately modeled — the schema's `behavior: instant` doesn't open the nightsoulBlessing state, so a standalone Q grants 15 NS that simply sits without drain. The dominant rotation is E (opens NS) → Q (boosts NS within the window).
Burst frames: burstFrames=InitAbilSlice(72), ActionAttack=71 ActionSkill=71 ActionJump=70 ActionSwap=69. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — D defaults to animLen=72.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 18*60). ConsumeEnergy(3) drains 3 energy from teammates; not modelled.

Kinetic Energy Scale: 12s base duration extended +3s via C6 (durationModifier on the summon, gated on constellation level 6 → 15s effective). Follows active character. Authored as a summons[] entry with mobility:follows. While the Scale is up, Iansan's NS Blessing persists even if Iansan is off-field — the schema's terminatesOnSwap on the skill is set to false to align. Note: the parallel atk-buff effect's `duration: 12` field is not C6-gated and stays at 12s; in-game the buff window matches the Scale lifetime.

ATK buff threshold (E3 v2.x, 2026-05-11): highATK=27% ATK (constant) when NS≥42, else lowATK×NS=0.5%×NS. Modelled as TWO buff effects with mutually-exclusive `stacks` conditions on the `nightsoul` key (using the same gainStacks/drain machinery the +54 E grant feeds). NS=1..41 → perStack value with `per: { stat: atk, ratio: 0.5 }` (effective stacks × 0.5% × ATK). NS≥42 → scaling value 27% × ATK with cap 690. Cap on the perStack tier is NOT enforced — schema's `perStack` BuffValue lacks a cap field today. In practice the perStack-tier cap only matters at very high ATK (NS=41 × 0.5% × ATK > 690 requires ATK > 3370); typical Iansan support builds sit below this, so the over-display is small. The cap on the ≥42 path uses `scaling.cap` which is currently metadata-only at the display layer (renderer doesn't enforce). Both gaps are shared with other characters using `scaling.cap` (Xianyun/Varesa/Yelan/Nilou) — fixing them is a separate cap-rendering pass.

C2 enhancement (+30% ATK% when Iansan off-field) authored on the C2 constellation node 2026-05-09 with `state: offField` condition. The renderer resolves off-field per-segment so the buff only renders on non-Iansan segments.
C6 +3s duration: not authored as cooldownModifier-style — would need a duration modifier on summons[] which the schema doesn't support yet.
abilities.description:
Iansan's stomping foot shatters the very earth with "Power," dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG. She then whips out her "Limited-Edition Kinetic Energy Scale (For Workouts)."
When this Skill is used, Iansan will gain 15 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
When the Kinetic Energy Scale leaves the field, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

Kinetic Energy Scale
The Kinetic Energy Scale will follow the character around, boosting the ATK of your current active party member in different ways based on Iansan's Nightsoul points.
· If Iansan has less than 42 Nightsoul points, the ATK bonus will be based on her Nightsoul points and ATK.
· If Iansan has at least 42 Nightsoul points, the Kinetic Energy Scale will switch to the "Ardent Support!" state, in which the ATK bonus will be stronger and based on her ATK alone.
Additionally, the Scale will log the distance your current active character (excluding Iansan) has moved so long as it is active, restoring Nightsoul points to Iansan every second based on the distance moved in the previous second.
The Scale will disappear once her Nightsoul's Blessing state ends. It will also disappear after 1 second when you are not in a state of combat. While it is active, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end even if she is not on the field.

passives.name: Enhanced Resistance Training
_curatorNotes: Precise Movement: triggered on Swift Stormflight hit (a1CB in charge.go), 15s self ATK +20%. Subsequently increases NS-restoration-via-Scale gain by +1 (default 1 → 2 with a1) or +4 if active char consumed/restored NS recently. Multiple gaps: (1) Swift Stormflight hit trigger isn't a clean onHit primitive (Swift is the empowered CA, but it's authored on the in-NS normal[1] chargeFrames and we don't have a per-CA-hit trigger); (2) the NS-gain modifier modifies the Scale's restore rate which itself isn't modelled; (3) the active-char-NS-state gate adds another runtime condition.

Effective at the +20% ATK level: Iansan gains a 15s self ATK buff after every Swift Stormflight hit. Could be authored as a self-target buff with onCast trigger... but onCast on which ability? The CA is on the normal entry which doesn't trigger onCast. This is the same gap as Yanfei A1's onHit trigger — flagged for future schema work.
passives.description:
After Swift Stormflight hits opponents, Iansan will gain the Precise Movement effect for 15s.
During this time, her ATK is increased by 20%, and whenever she regains Nightsoul points through the Kinetic Energy Scale in her Elemental Burst, The Three Principles of Power, she will gain 1 extra Nightsoul point. Additionally, when your current active party member consumes or restores Nightsoul points, the extra Nightsoul points Iansan gains the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale will be increased to 4. This effect can occur once every 2.8s.
"Precise Movement" will expire when Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

passives.name: Kinetic Energy Gradient Test
_curatorNotes: Warming Up: triggered on team Nightsoul Burst event (event.OnNightsoulBurst), 10s buff window. During the window, every NS-restoration tick (which happens every 2.8s) heals active char for 60% Iansan's ATK. The onTeamNightsoulBurst trigger primitive landed 2026-05-09 (F2C); remaining gap is the heal-on-NS-restore (gated on Scale ticks which we don't model). Heal effect not authored — flagged.
Active-target NB rendering not yet wired in the renderer (only self-target + team-target NB passes shipped 2026-05-09 since no in-scope migration needed active routing). Add when this heal lands.
passives.description:
When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Iansan will obtain the Warming Up effect for 10s.
During this time, when Iansan restores at least 1 Nightsoul point, she will heal your current active character for 60% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2.8s.

constellations.name: Starting's Never Easy
_curatorNotes: C1: per 6 NS points consumed in NS Blessing, +15 Energy to Iansan, 18s ICD. Modelled internally via c1Points accumulator. Not authorable as a clean Effect — gating on NS-consumption-count + 18s ICD is two layers of state we don't track. Energy gain on NS depletion could be authored as an afterDuration trigger (gating on stance end) but that misrepresents the actual mechanic (the energy fires mid-stance, not on exit).
constellations.description: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

constellations.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
_curatorNotes: C2 has two effects: (1) Q cast grants Iansan the A1 Precise Movement buff (+20% ATK self, 15s) — authored as self atk% buff with onCast burst trigger and constellation:2 condition. (2) When Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, +30% ATK% to active char — authored 2026-05-09 against the renderer's per-segment off-field resolution: the buff renders only on segments where Iansan is NOT the active character. The Precise-Movement-must-be-active sub-condition is conservatively treated as always-true here (Q cast grants Precise Movement at the same moment, so for the 15s window it's coincident).
constellations.description: When using the Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.

constellations.name: Scientific Diet Planning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Thunderbolt Rush by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
_curatorNotes: C4 (Surging Force): when Scale is up and active (non-Iansan) char casts burst, gain 2 stacks. Each stack consumed per Scale NS-restoration tick for +4 NS. Plus overflow handling: 50% of overflow added to next NS restore. All gates on Scale ticks (not modelled) and team-burst-cast trigger (afterCast on teammate's Q — schema's onCast trigger is character-scoped). Not authored — stack interactions with the Scale system are too removed from the schema to express usefully.
constellations.description:
When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points.
Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.

constellations.name: We Can Push It Further!
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of The Three Principles of Power by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 Quick Schema Wins: authored the +3s Kinetic Energy Scale duration extension as a durationModifier on the burst summon (constellation level 6).
C6 second half (Extreme Force, +25% active-char DMG for 3s when Iansan triggers NS-restoration with overflow) gates on Scale tick events + overflow detection — neither modelled. Not authored.
constellations.description:
The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s.
Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.
